select CAL_B2K_TYPE CAL_B2K_TYPE2,SCD_START_DATE SCD_START_DATE_2, SCD_END_DATE SCD_END_DATE_2,* from (
SELECT CAL_B2K_TYPE CAL_B2K_TYPE2, * FROM
EDS.DEP_HOLIDAYMASTTABLE WHERE CAL_B2K_TYPE='BRANCH' AND  CAL_B2K_ID='1587' AND MMYYYY='021984'
UNION ALL
SELECT CAL_B2K_TYPE CAL_B2K_TYPE2, * FROM
EDS.DEP_HOLIDAYMASTTABLE WHERE CAL_B2K_TYPE='BRANCH' AND  CAL_B2K_ID='1058' AND MMYYYY='082051'
UNION ALL
SELECT CAL_B2K_TYPE CAL_B2K_TYPE2, * FROM
EDS.DEP_HOLIDAYMASTTABLE WHERE CAL_B2K_TYPE='BRANCH' AND  CAL_B2K_ID='1302' AND MMYYYY='021984'
UNION ALL
SELECT CAL_B2K_TYPE CAL_B2K_TYPE2, * FROM
EDS.DEP_HOLIDAYMASTTABLE WHERE CAL_B2K_TYPE='9999' AND  CAL_B2K_ID='999' AND MMYYYY='999999') temp order by CAL_B2K_ID, SCD_START_DATE


DELETE FROM [d360].[STG_EDS_DEP_HOLIDAYMASTTABLE] 
WHERE CAL_B2K_TYPE='BRANCH' AND  CAL_B2K_ID='1058' AND MMYYYY='082051' AND H = 'D';
